candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order /v1/orders fails with 502; the order service is the failing dependency, not the gateway itself.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/metrics are absent, so the specific order failure mode (config, DB, or dependency) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: All checkout 502s correlate with gateway client POSTs to order /v1/orders returning 502 at low latency, indicating fast downstream failure. Gateway health endpoints are 200. Root cause lies downstream at order, but order-side evidence is missing, so a single generic http-500 candidate is offered with moderate confidence.
